invariants: A-001 without a verified identity no authorization succeeds
A-002 the effective tenant comes from IS-001; this component derives no tenant of its own
A-003 a caller-supplied tenant_id is a cross-check only and is never a source of tenant identity
A-004 a subject of one Tenant never reaches a resource of another Tenant
A-005 authentication by itself grants no access
A-006 absence of an explicit permission is a denial
A-007 a Tenant in suspended, deletion_requested, deleted or provisioning state gets no ordinary tenant-scoped access
A-008 the final enforcement belongs to the component that owns the data; this component decides and never enforces
A-009 every decision and every refused request is audited with request_id and correlation_id
A-010 the internals of this component are not a consumer contract: a consumer receives the published client and values only

operations.purpose: decide whether a verified subject may perform one operation on one tenant-scoped resource
operations.idempotency_note: The operation changes no state of this component beyond its append-only audit journal, so ARCHITECTURE.md §6.5 (Idempotency-Key for state-changing operations) does not apply; repeating the request produces a decision, never a second effect.

request: verified subject: the credential presented by the subject, verified through IS-001 — never a claim about who the subject is
effective tenant context: derived by IS-001 from the verified identity
resource: type, id and the Tenant that owns it, stated by the data owner
operation: the action the data owner is about to perform
response: reason: one stable code from the published set

consumer_surface.transport: authorization_service.transport.open_channel + authorization_service.transport.call_contract — the published HTTP contract executed in process over an opaque channel handle (ARCHITECTURE.md §1.1 interaction mode API, Level 0)
errors: authorization_service.errors.CallerNotAuthenticated — the asking component presented no verifiable service identity (401)
authorization_service.errors.CallerNotAuthorized — the asking component may not ask for decisions, or belongs to another Platform Instance (403)
authorization_service.errors.MalformedDecisionRequest — the question itself is unanswerable (422); it is refused, not answered DENY
authorization_service.errors.ContractViolation — the component answered outside its contract; a consumer must fail closed
guarantees: values only: no grant store, audit journal, engine reference, policy object or grant mutation is reachable through the published surface

the published client holds no callable: its state is a channel handle and a credential, so walking __closure__ and cell_contents of the client and of its class reaches neither the component's ASGI application nor its deployment, engine or store
the ASGI application is never handed out: it stays behind the provider-side channel table, and a channel is revoked when the consumer drops the client
importing the published module binds no reference to authorization_service.transport — its namespace holds no module object, no channel table and no transport type
an unknown or revoked channel handle raises ContractViolation, so there is no permissive fallback and a handle cannot be guessed
every decision is produced by the same routing, service-identity authentication, permission check and audit code that serves an HTTP request
the asking service identity comes from the credential bound to the client and cannot be chosen by the caller
a DENY is returned as a value: the consumer performs the enforcement itself, and nothing the client returns can read, write or serve a resource
a decision cannot be turned into a grant: the surface has no grant, revoke, list or read operation over permissions
composition_root_only: the contract application itself (the ASGI application) — a consumer component must not own or re-export it
the contract channel table authorization_service.transport._CHANNELS — a handle-to-application mapping owned by the component
consumer_surface.note: The deployment object is composition-internal: it assembles engine, store and contract application for the composition root and for this component's own tests and is never handed to a consumer. This component composes no other component and publishes no module-level demo application: a demo of an authorization boundary needs a composed Platform Instance, which is the job of a composition root.

consumes.mechanism: contract client over the published API of identity, executed in process at Level 0
consumes.note: The verified subject and the effective tenant of a request come from IS-001. This component has no identity verification and no tenant derivation of its own, so no second tenant-context mechanism can exist here (A-002).

consumes.mechanism: contract client over the published API of tenant_authority, executed in process at Level 0
consumes.credential_source: deployment secret resolved by the composition root: the service identity of this component
consumes.note: The Tenant lifecycle verdict is read at decision time and never cached: a Tenant suspended between two decisions is denied on the next one (A-007).

refusal_semantics.principle: a refused question and a negative answer are different facts
refusal_semantics.answered: HTTP 200 with decision ALLOW or DENY; a DENY is data the consumer must enforce, not a transport failure

events.note: IS-003 publishes no inter-component events and does not simulate a broker. The audit journal is owned data, not a public event contract.

data_export_cdc.note: No CDC or bulk export stream is implemented in IS-003.

ui.note: Class B Platform Service; a permission administration UI is an explicit non-goal of IS-003.

platform_id.description: Identifier of the Platform Instance this boundary serves; a service identity of another Platform Instance may not ask it for decisions.

notes: A permission grant exists inside exactly one Tenant (LAW-16a): the same subject in another Tenant is another grant, and no grant crosses a tenant boundary.
This component owns no tenant registry, no tenant lifecycle state and no identity: those belong to tenant_authority (T-004) and identity, and are read through their published contracts.
There is no public grant management API: provisioning grants is an internal operation of the composition root, and user/credential/permission administration is an explicit non-goal of IS-003.

audit.journal: internal append-only journal owned by authorization
audit.note: Audit is owned data, not a public event contract, and is not readable through the published surface.

observability.saga_id: absent — this component runs no inter-component sagas

authn.note: The asking component authenticates with its own service identity (§6.2). The subject is never authenticated here: the presented subject credential is verified by IS-001 through its published contract.

authz.enforcement_point: the component that owns the data

compatibility_policy.reason_codes: adding a reason code is a minor change; removing or redefining one is a breaking change
compatibility_policy.decision_chain: reordering or removing a check is a breaking change: the order is part of the published behaviour
